rules.statement: The plaintiffs are entitled to a right of servitude over the defendants' land for a footpath and water course, even if they cannot show that this was specifically granted.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems to me, therefore, that even assuming that the plaintiff is not in a position to show that the right of way had been granted over the Eastern portion, he is entitled by virtue of the right conferred on him by law to elect and to claim the right of way over the Eastern portion of defendants' land along lot 4."
